breakdown.description: The prescribed global x-directed shear traction is replaced by a boundary-normal pressure on the slope
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to treat the load on the sloping edge as a 'uniform inward normal pressure'. The ground truth corrects this to be a 'global x-directed traction'. The generated specification correctly describes the load as 'a uniform horizontal force of τ_x = 2000 Pa in the global positive x-direction on the sloping edge', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth and fixes the error.
